text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: Nakayama Festa had been injured, so I had her resting in the nurse's office, but—

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text: Hey, we're getting back to training.

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text:
It's not an injury worth making a fuss over in the first place.
The pain's already long gone anyway.

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text: Just lying around when there's nothing even wrong with me is the height of boredom.

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text: ...Even so, you're telling me to just rest?
choice_data_list: Getting proper rest is important, you know.
Then let's move as much as you can within reason.

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text:
If I wasn't feeling well, I'd do that.
But right now, there ain't a thing wrong with me, y'know?
choice_data_list: You need strict bed rest to avoid causing any problems.

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text: ...Haa, you really just won't break, huh.

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text:
Fine, I'll back off for today.
Don't wanna waste stamina on things that won't change the outcome.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Saying so, Nakayama Festa reluctantly
left the infirmary.

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text:
"Within reason, huh...
Well, whatever. It's better than just lying in bed."

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text:
...Good grief,
things never just roll our way, do they?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: The injury seemed to be worse than expected, and I ended up taking Nakayama Festa back to the infirmary once again.

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text: ...Looks like I can run just fine if it's only this much.

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text: I don't push things to the absolute limit. That's not taking a gamble—that's just closing off your own path with your own hands.

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text: Alright, let's do one more run with that exact same pacing.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Afterward, Nakayama Festa continued her training
to the extent that it wouldn't agitate her injury.
